CLICK_INTERVAL.desc: How long the script waits between each repeated click while the click-and-hold hotkey is held down. Lower it to click faster; raise it to click slower and more gently.

CONFIDENCE.desc: How closely the screen must match the target image before the script clicks it. Lower it if the click never triggers because the match is never confident enough; raise it if it ends up clicking the wrong thing.

REVIVE_WAIT.desc: How long the script waits, in seconds, after you die before it even tries clicking Revive -- the button isn't clickable immediately after death. Raise it if the button is still being clicked too early and failing.

REVIVE_RETRY.desc: Once the initial wait is over, how often (in seconds) the script re-checks whether the Revive button has become clickable yet. Lower it to react faster once it is.

CONF_WH.desc: How closely the screen must match the reference image of the warehouse panel before the script considers the warehouse detected/open. Lower this if the script fails to notice the warehouse even though it's clearly open; raise it if the script mistakenly thinks the warehouse is open when it isn't.

WAIT.desc: How long the script pauses, in seconds, between each step of its sequence. Lower it to speed the script up if your game and PC respond quickly; raise it if steps start failing because the game's UI hasn't caught up yet.

RETRIES.desc: How many times the script checks for a UI element to appear before giving up and clicking its best guess anyway. Raise it if elements sometimes take a while to show up on your PC; lower it to fail faster and move on to the next step sooner.

CONF_INV.desc: How closely the screen must match the reference image of the inventory panel before the script considers the inventory detected/open. Lower this if inventory detection keeps failing; raise it if it falsely detects the inventory when it's actually closed.

WAIT.desc: How long the script pauses, in seconds, between each step of its sequence. Lower it to speed the script up if your game and PC respond quickly; raise it if steps start failing because the game's UI hasn't caught up yet.

WH_TAB_COUNT.desc: How many warehouse tabs this script cycles through. Set this to match how many tabs you actually use for it.

CONF_WH.desc: How closely the screen must match the reference image of the warehouse panel before the script considers the warehouse detected/open. Lower this if the script fails to notice the warehouse even though it's clearly open; raise it if the script mistakenly thinks the warehouse is open when it isn't.

CONF_EMPTY.desc: How closely a grid slot must match the 'empty cell' reference image before it's treated as empty. Lower it if occupied slots get wrongly skipped as empty; raise it if empty slots get wrongly counted as items.

CLICK_MULTIPLIER.desc: How many extra clicks the script makes on the warehouse, as a multiple of the item count it detected (1.5 = 50% extra clicks, as a safety margin). Raise it if items keep getting left behind; lower it if it's clicking too many times or grabbing more than you want.

VIS.desc: Turns the on-screen debug overlay on (1) or off (0). It draws boxes over whatever the script is currently detecting -- handy for troubleshooting, but not needed for normal runs.

CYCLES.desc: How many times the full compose sequence repeats within a single run. Raise it to process more items in one run; lower it to keep each run shorter.

WAREHOUSE_MIN_ITEMS.desc: The minimum number of items that must be sitting in the warehouse before this script bothers starting its routine at all. Raise it to only run on bigger batches; lower it to run even when there are just a few items.

CONF_INV.desc: How closely the screen must match the reference image of the inventory panel before the script considers the inventory detected/open. Lower this if inventory detection keeps failing; raise it if it falsely detects the inventory when it's actually closed.

CONF_DIALOG.desc: How closely the screen must match the compose dialog's reference image before the script considers that dialog open. Lower it if the script fails to notice the dialog; raise it if it falsely thinks the dialog is open.

WAIT.desc: How long the script pauses, in seconds, between each step of its sequence. Lower it to speed the script up if your game and PC respond quickly; raise it if steps start failing because the game's UI hasn't caught up yet.

DRAGONBALL_NEED.desc: The minimum number of dragonballs that must be in the inventory before the script right-clicks one to convert them into a scroll. Raise it to wait for a bigger stack first; lower it to convert sooner.

CONF_WH.desc: How closely the screen must match the reference image of the warehouse panel before the script considers the warehouse detected/open. Lower this if the script fails to notice the warehouse even though it's clearly open; raise it if the script mistakenly thinks the warehouse is open when it isn't.

CONF_EMPTY.desc: How closely a grid slot must match the 'empty cell' reference image before it's treated as empty. Lower it if occupied slots get wrongly skipped as empty; raise it if empty slots get wrongly counted as items.

CONF_ARROW.desc: How closely a slot must match the arrow icon before it's recognized as an arrow stack. Lower it if arrows aren't being detected; raise it if other items get mistaken for arrows.

CONF_VIP_BTN.desc: How closely the screen must match the VIP button's reference image before the script clicks it. Lower it if the button isn't being found; raise it if the script clicks the wrong thing.

CONF_COMPOSE.desc: How closely the screen must match the compose button's reference image before the script clicks it. Lower it if the button isn't being found; raise it if the script clicks the wrong thing.

CONF_DEPOSIT.desc: How closely the screen must match the deposit button's reference image before the script clicks it. Lower it if the button isn't being found; raise it if the script clicks the wrong thing.

CONF_CLOSE_VIP.desc: How closely the screen must match the close-VIP button's reference image before the script clicks it. Lower it if the button isn't being found; raise it if the script clicks the wrong thing.

WAREHOUSE_MIN_ITEMS.desc: The minimum number of items that must be sitting in the warehouse before this script bothers starting its routine at all. Raise it to only run on bigger batches; lower it to run even when there are just a few items.

WH_TAB_COUNT.desc: How many warehouse tabs this script cycles through. Set this to match how many tabs you actually use for it.

CONF_INV.desc: How closely the screen must match the reference image of the inventory panel before the script considers the inventory detected/open. Lower this if inventory detection keeps failing; raise it if it falsely detects the inventory when it's actually closed.

Lower this if the script fails to notice the warehouse even though it's clearly open; raise it if the script mistakenly thinks the warehouse is open when it isn't.

CONF_ARROW.desc: How closely a slot must match the arrow icon before it's recognized as an arrow stack. Lower it if arrows aren't being detected; raise it if other items get mistaken for arrows.

ARROW_TAB_INDEX.desc: Which warehouse tab (counting from 0) is set aside for arrows. Change this if you keep your arrows in a different tab than tab 7.

BANK_TAB_COUNT.desc: How many of your warehouse tabs are treated as regular item tabs, separate from the arrow tab. Adjust this if your own tab setup differs.

WH_TAB_COUNT.desc: How many warehouse tabs this script cycles through. Set this to match how many tabs you actually use for it.

CONF.desc: General match confidence used for slot classification in this script. Lower it if slots keep getting misclassified as empty/junk; raise it if it's too eager to treat slots as items.

CONF_WH.desc: How closely the screen must match the reference image of the warehouse panel before the script considers the warehouse detected/open. Lower this if the script fails to notice the warehouse even though it's clearly open; raise it if the script mistakenly thinks the warehouse is open when it isn't.

CONF_EMPTY.desc: How closely a grid slot must match the 'empty cell' reference image before it's treated as empty. Lower it if occupied slots get wrongly skipped as empty; raise it if empty slots get wrongly counted as items.

ALT_HOLD.desc: How long the script holds down Alt before and after each stash click. Raise it if items sometimes fail to get sent to the warehouse -- this gives the game more time to register the modifier key.

TAB_DELAY.desc: How long the script waits after clicking a warehouse tab before it does the Alt+click to stash an item into it. Raise it if items land in the wrong tab because the tab switch hadn't finished yet.

STASH_DELAY.desc: How long the script waits between moving each item into the warehouse. Lower it to stash faster; raise it if items start getting skipped or misplaced.
